articles.title: Binance $6.3B record hack sparks pre-election political clashes
articles.snippet: Some political and administration figures tried to make hay of the biggest-ever crypto heist.

articles.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

articles.title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
articles.snippet: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.

articles.title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
articles.snippet: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.
